title: Access request verification shows 0 requests despite agent claiming completion
description: Agent narration claims Goal 8 (add-to-toolkit) was completed, but verification shows 0 access requests filed or approved. This indicates either the agent used CLI commands that bypassed API tracking, or the harness verification is not capturing CLI-based actions.
symptoms: Verification shows 0 access requests in system
Agent may have used CLI instead of API
Requests not persisted or not visible to verification
root_cause_hint: Harness verification may only check API-based access requests and not capture CLI-generated requests, or CLI actions are not properly seeded/tracked in the test database.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Agent narration claims Goal 8 complete, but verification shows 0 access requests filed or approved. Agent may have used CLI instead of API, or requests were not persisted.'
Logged observation: 'Agent narration mentions 'blocker for Goal 9' and moving forward, but verification shows 0 access requests exist. Access verification failed.'

title: Inspect endpoint verification shows 0 requests despite agent claiming completion
description: Agent narration claims Goal 10 (inspect-before-execute) was completed, but verification shows 0 POST requests to /inspect endpoint, indicating the agent did not actually use the inspect functionality or the verification is not capturing the requests.
symptoms: Mismatch between agent narration and actual API usage
root_cause_hint: Agent may have skipped the actual inspect API call, or verification is not properly capturing inspect endpoint usage. May also indicate agent is reporting completion without actually performing the task.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Agent narration claims Goal 10 complete, but verification shows 0 POST requests to /inspect endpoint. Inspect functionality was not actually used.'
